_doc: 版本標識檔。guardian＝Workflow Guardian（hooks + MCP server）版本，Dashboard 標題與 MCP serverInfo 顯示；atom_memory＝原子記憶系統版本；release_date＝此版本正式發布日；release_theme＝此版本主題一句話。程式讀者：tools/workflow-guardian-mcp/lib/paths.js（只取 guardian / atom_memory）與 tools/install.py --verify（確認本檔可讀）；文件讀者 TECH.md。
release_theme: The per-session summary extension (episodic) is removed together with the core hook points that served only it; install --upgrade uninstalls extensions no longer shipped and --verify flags leftovers; config keys read with code defaults are documented and keys nothing acted on are dropped; atom-heal diagnostic ids no longer depend on the machine path; small fixes to factory-card wording, .gitignore, the _staging naming hint and the settings note in TECH
